rationale: Internally consistent and the specific triple has not been run, but it is a modest recombination of two already-tested legs (champion + DemandDurabilityInnovator's stability condition) whose main documented effect in this archive is that added MIN legs shrink alpha and coverage, so the expected information gain is limited to a Sharpe/robustness diagnostic.

This is essentially MarketShareValidatedInnovator with the intangible leg swapped from flow intensity to equity-scaled stock — a one-knob variant of an already-evaluated signal — and it also contains a redundant construction (IND_RANK of an IND_ADJ variable is close to a no-op transformation of the within-industry ranking), so it adds little beyond the existing result.

A legitimate untested cell of the credibility × intangible-scaling grid with a coherent mechanism, though it remains a substitution of one previously tested credibility proxy for another and the oancf/oibdp ratio is unstable near zero denominators even after winsorizing, so gains are likely marginal.

The expression contains no leg that selects hidden-capital-intensive firms — adding the intangible stock to the denominator mechanically *penalizes* intangible-heavy firms, contradicting the stated mismeasurement story — leaving what is effectively the well-known gross-profitability × accrual-quality double sort with a minor denominator tweak.

Consistent construction with a defensible timing/reverse-causality argument, but it is a single-leg swap on MaturedIntangibleInvestmentValidation (cash-level → accrual credibility) and the lagged intensity leg is highly autocorrelated with contemporaneous intensity, so it is a mild refinement rather than a new mechanism, with coverage cost.

The sign follows directly from the expression and the ex-ante prediction is honest, but a large part of the effect is the published accrual anomaly restricted to intangible-heavy firms, and because ib−oancf is positively correlated with reported profitability the signal may partly re-express the already-documented negative purchased-intangible/high-profitability corner rather than testing a distinct channel.
